subject: [PATCH v5 09/19] selftests/mm: add folio-order detection self-check

2026-09-08.patch_summary: This patch adds a self-test to verify the accuracy of the vm_util folio-order helpers, is_backed_by_folio() and is_range_backed_by_order(). The test faults in memory for each supported anonymous huge page order, enabling only that order, and checks if the helpers correctly report the backing order. This ensures that the khugepaged mTHP tests are reliable. The test has been verified on x86-64 and arm64 architectures.
